wind.of.label: OpenFOAM (Okwengeziwe)
wind.of.note: Isebenzisa ukufakwa kwakho kwe-OpenFOAM ngohlelo oluncane lomsizi kulolu khompyutha: icala elilodwa le-RANS (k-epsilon) ngayinye yendlela yomoya, ukungena kwesendlalelo somoya esiyisimo sezulu. Akukho okuphuma kulolu khompyutha. I-CadCraft ayifaki i-OpenFOAM.
wind.of.down: Umsizi awuphendulanga ({why}). Uqalise kulolu khompyutha: node cc-openfoam-runner.mjs serve
wind.of.nofoam: Umsizi uphendule kodwa awukwazanga ukuqalisa i-OpenFOAM: {why}
wind.of.install: Faka i-OpenFOAM (i-ESI v-series, openfoam.com) kanye nomsizi kusukela kufolda yokwengeziwe; isihloko sosizo sichaza kokubili.
